description: This file defines configuration structures and enums related to push notification build settings, including transport mode, distribution mode, APNs environment, and URL validation logic.

classes.name: PushBuildConfig
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates build configuration for push notifications, including transport, distribution, relay URL, and APNs environment.

methods.name: init(bundle: Bundle)
methods.description: Initializes a PushBuildConfig instance by reading configuration values from the provided bundle.

methods.name: usesRelay
methods.description: Boolean property indicating whether the transport mode is relay.

methods.name: readURL(bundle: Bundle, key: String) -> URL?
methods.description: Reads and validates a URL string from the bundle for the specified key, ensuring it is a valid HTTPS URL with no user info, password, query, or fragment.

methods.name: readEnum<T: RawRepresentable>(bundle: Bundle, key: String, fallback: T) -> T
methods.description: Reads a string value from the bundle and converts it to the corresponding enum case, falling back to a default if conversion fails.
